description: Defines the Dumper class in the android::utils namespace, which provides methods for dumping variables and data structures as formatted strings, including support for indentation and sections.

classes.name: Dumper
classes.description: A utility class for dumping variables and data structures into a string with formatting, indentation, and section support.

methods.name: Dumper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Dumper with a reference to an output string.

methods.name: eol
methods.description: Appends a newline character to the output string.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Overloaded methods to dump variables of different types (string, bool, optional, user-defined types) with optional formatting.

methods.name: Indent
methods.description: Helper struct to manage indentation scope, increasing indentation on creation and decreasing on destruction.

methods.name: Section
methods.description: Helper struct to create a section with a heading, managing indentation and formatting.
